evidence.quote: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a high image quality, high productivity ink jet recorder having a high drying speed in which blur is suppressed, reproducibility of gradation is improved and ejecting direction is stabilized.

PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an ink jet head capable of forming an image with a high image quality by cutting ink well at the time of ink ejection thereby ejecting an ink drop having predetermined size stably in a specified direction, and to provide a recorder and a recording method employing it.

PURPOSE:To obtain an ink jet recorder having no possibility of error ink dis charge by providing a specific flow path resistance generation part in an ink flow path which supplies an ink to an ink discharge part made of a slit-form space.

analysis.heterogeneity: 该聚类包含多种技术领域，包括喷墨记录方法、压电元件、声学转换器等，技术手段差异较大。
